applicabilityBasis.summary: mMEV is a Midas Software GmbH tokenized bearer debt security under its February 2, 2026 key-information document, with redemption based on hypothetical best-efforts liquidation of the market-neutral strategy underlying less fees. Redemption follows underlying portfolio performance or NAV and does not promise a fixed USD 1 payment obligation. The documented debt-security/investment-certificate structure supports the tracker excluded-security classification.

genius.licensingRegulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority under the EU Prospectus Regulation; Midas Software GmbH is not FMA-licensed)
genius.notes: GENIUS section 2(22) requires fixed monetary-value redemption and separately excludes securities. This tracker perimeter classification follows the token-specific investment-certificate/debt-security documents and is not a U.S. judicial or regulatory securities determination. FMA prospectus approval is a document review, not issuer licensing or GENIUS approval. No U.S. issuer pathway, federal regulator, state regulator or foreign-issuer registration is asserted. The February 2, 2026 KID specifies performance-linked redemption less fees and identifies Midas Software GmbH as issuer of the bearer debt security. The April 30 issuer recap announced discontinuation on May 10, 2026 and directed holders to withdraw or reinvest in mROX. This assessment covers the documented instrument without asserting a current primary offering; the lifecycle notice is not regulatory enforcement. Current platform eligibility assertions are omitted because the cited eligibility page could not be independently reopened.
